live_behavior_protocol: For every model-specific directory, replay all 500 clean and 500 corrupt V0 prompts through the experiment runner's exact input rendering and target checkpoint in both its canonical batch size and batch size 1. Require exact intended top-1 behavior for every replay.
partition_rule: Every model directory contains exactly 200 train pairs and 300 held-out pairs. Clean and corrupt verb counts are balanced independently within each split.
replay_policy: No boundary-drift exception is allowed by the experiment runner.
